about_the_game:
Anti-Extinction is a genre-defining sci-fi RPG that introduces True Non-Repeatable Gameplay™—a world where no two playthroughs are ever the same. Every action shapes AI-driven faction wars, rewrites history, and alters the very fabric of reality. Built by Furr-Tec Studios, this is more than just a game—it is a living universe where the only certainty is change.

Harness quantum-powered encryption and PassKeys, ensuring unprecedented security with no kernel-level anti-cheat or passwords. Explore a vast, real-world-scale environment powered by Unity Sentis, where fluid dynamics, weather, power grids, and AI-driven ecosystems evolve dynamically.

Unravel the secrets of the Progenitors, wield physics-breaking technology, and navigate factions that grow, adapt, and war independently of player input. With AI-driven horror mechanics, procedural civilizations, and next-gen simulation technology, Anti-Extinction isn’t just an RPG—it’s the next evolution of emergent gameplay.

📍 True Non-Repeatable Gameplay™

  • AI-driven factions adapt dynamically, ensuring no two playthroughs unfold the same way.

  • Decisions permanently alter history, alliances, and the world’s technological evolution.

  • No scripted encounters—every battle, every alliance, and every event emerges from player action and AI decision-making.

🌍 Real-World Scale Worldbuilding & Advanced Simulation

  • Procedural, physics-driven ecosystems—where terrain erodes, climates shift, and the world reacts to natural forces.

  • Unity Sentis-powered environmental physics—dynamic water flow, atmospheric changes, and material wear-and-tear.

  • Terraforming & Infrastructure Restoration—rebuild civilizations, reactivate power grids, and reconstruct lost cities.

⚙️ Next-Gen AI Systems & Quantum-Powered Security

  • Quantum Encryption & PassKeys—eliminates passwords, prevents breaches, and removes the need for invasive anti-cheat.

  • AI-driven factions—rival governments, corporations, and survivor enclaves evolve and strategize in real-time.

  • Adaptive Horror Engine—mental stability mechanics cause hallucinations, time loops, and reality distortions.

🏗️ Base-Building & Infrastructure Systems

  • Construct modular settlements that grow dynamically with AI populations.

  • Furr-Tec Engineering & Logistics—players must restore lost technology, including factories, power plants, and research labs.

  • Strategic resource management—rebuild society using rare Progenitor artifacts and engineered solutions.

⚔️ High-Precision Tactical Combat & Dimensional Warfare

  • Physics-Based Destruction—structures collapse realistically, and terrain can be weaponized.

  • Customizable Weapons & Progenitor Tech—upgrade gear with dimensional rifts, Arcai energy, and ancient blueprints.

  • Strategic Combat AI—enemies learn from past encounters, making each battle unpredictable.

🧠 Factions, Politics, & Dynamic Diplomacy

  • AI-driven political systems—factions wage war, broker peace, and evolve independent of player control.

  • Global & Local Influence—players manipulate entire civilizations or operate as a lone strategist.

  • Economy, trade, & espionage mechanics—sabotage supply chains, broker intelligence, or engineer coups.

🔹Exploration & The Maelstrom’s Cosmic Horrors

  • The Maelstrom—a reality-breaking force where time fractures, physics collapse, and eldritch horrors emerge.

  • Ancient Progenitor Ruins—unlock forbidden technologies that bend space-time itself.

  • Temporal Rifts & Astral Gateways—explore past, present, and future convergences.

🔹 Multiplayer & Social Features

  • Persistent World Servers—players can host ever-changing civilizations that grow, war, and evolve dynamically. (Coming soon)

  • Faction Wars & Player-Led Governments—form alliances, engage in warfare, and redefine the balance of power.

  • Cooperative Survival—band together to reclaim lost regions, fight the Maelstrom’s horrors, and shape the future.

🔹 Furr-Tec’s Mission: Against Corporate Greed

Furr-Tec Studios is independent—and will remain that way. We stand against corporate greed and monetization abuse.

  • No pay-to-win mechanics.

  • No predatory microtransactions.

  • No corporate interference.

We create games for players, not investors. Every decision, from game design to pricing, is made to prioritize artistic integrity, gameplay depth, and the community's vision.

🔹 Our Vision: The Future of Emergent Gaming

We aren’t just making another RPG—we are pioneering a new standard for immersive, ever-evolving worlds.

  • Quality Over Quantity—we craft masterpieces, not content mills.

  • Innovation at the Core—from AI-driven gameplay to quantum-secured online infrastructure.

  • Community-Driven Development—your voice shapes the evolution of our worlds.

This isn’t just another game—
Anti-Extinction is the start of a revolution.
